nodes.label: Rainmeter Temporal Smoothing Formula
nodes.rationale: Uses Rainmeter's exact k-constant calculation: k = 0.01 ^ (1 / (FPS * TimeInSeconds)) for temporal attack, decay, and alpha parameters to replicate native visualizer physics cleanly.

nodes.label: Monstercat Spatial Smoothing
nodes.rationale: Replicates the spatial tapers and divisor coefficients of the Monstercat Rainmeter skin, dynamically scaling the inner 9 bars on the left and right edges depending on visualizer resolution.

nodes.label: Smart Pause/Wake Visualizer Stream
nodes.rationale: Optimizes visualizer thread resource utilization by monitoring connected browser clients and active track states, pausing raw audio capturing loops during silence or idle periods to conserve CPU.

nodes.label: Discord Activity Metadata Scrubbing
nodes.rationale: Performs deep metadata scrub of song titles to remove redundant artist suffixes, video brackets (e.g. '[Official Music Video]'), and licensing tags to keep Discord RPC display elegant.
